answer: Here is one mechanism that works: score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because garden only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. In practice shale is enforced by the ledger itself: The cost curve is the deterrent: honest agents pay it once, farms pay it per identity. Any jade approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
